sn9.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Nāgadatto Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn9.7:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgadatto atikālena gāmaṃ pavisati atidivā paṭikkamati || || 3.
sn9.7:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmato Nāgadattassa anukampikā atthakāmā āyasmantaṃ Nāgadattam saṃvejetu-kāmā yenāyasmā Nāgadatto ten-upasaṅkami || || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Nāgadattaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.7:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Nāgadatto tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādī ti || || 1.
